why: The answer depends on stratospheric ozone being the shield against UV-B, so that its depletion raises UV-B exposure and with it the incidence of skin cancer.
note: Topic gap. The Environmental Issues list has four rows and none is ozone depletion; 'Global Warming and International Climate Agreements' is a different global issue (greenhouse gases) and filing ozone there would blur the two issues students most often confuse. NCERT keeps them distinct - the chapter summary names 'increasing greenhouse effect' and 'depletion of ozone in the stratosphere' as two separate global issues (verified at ncert BIO12O ch16 p016). There is no 'Unspecified Topic' placeholder in this chapter.
proposed_topic: Ozone Depletion in the Stratosphere (CFCs, UV-B and Its Effects)
